<h1 class="csf-hero__title">Everything here can be made in a <em>bedroom</em></h1>

<p class="csf-hero__lede">
These are the recipes we make together at a session, and they are all deliberately
chosen for the same reason: a bowl, a knife and a fridge is the entire equipment list.
Take any of them home and you can do it again on your own.
</p>

::: {.csf-actions}
[Come and make one](join.qmd){.csf-btn .csf-btn--primary}
:::
:::

::: {.csf-section}
<p class="csf-section__kicker">The house speciality</p>
<h2 class="csf-section__title">Desserts, because heat is the thing you don't have</h2>
<p class="csf-section__sub">
Dessert is where cooking without fire stops being a limitation and starts being an
advantage. Almost nothing good in this category was ever baked.
</p>

::: {.csf-grid}
::: {.csf-card}
<span class="csf-card__icon"><i class="bi bi-cookie"></i></span>

### Salame di cioccolato
The one we make most. Crush dry biscuits in a bag, melt dark chocolate with butter,
mix with a little sugar, roll it into a log in baking paper and put it in the fridge
for two hours. It slices like a salami and it never fails.
:::

::: {.csf-card}
<span class="csf-card__icon"><i class="bi bi-cup-hot"></i></span>

### Tiramisù
No bake by definition. Mascarpone, eggs, sugar, coffee, savoiardi, cocoa. The only
hard part is not moving the tray too fast on the way to the fridge.
:::

::: {.csf-card}
<span class="csf-card__icon"><i class="bi bi-cake2"></i></span>

### No bake cheesecake
A crushed biscuit and butter base pressed into a tin, cream cheese whipped with sugar
and lemon on top, then several hours of doing nothing at all. Looks like the hardest
thing on this page and is the easiest.
:::

::: {.csf-card}
<span class="csf-card__icon"><i class="bi bi-basket"></i></span>

### Fruit with lemon and sugar
Chop whatever is in season, add sugar and lemon juice, thirty minutes in the fridge and
it makes its own syrup. Costs almost nothing and everybody takes some.
:::

::: {.csf-card}
<span class="csf-card__icon"><i class="bi bi-egg"></i></span>

### Chocolate mousse, two ingredients
Dark chocolate and cream, whipped. That is the whole recipe. Good in small glasses,
and it makes the room smell like a much more serious kitchen than it is.
:::

::: {.csf-card}
<span class="csf-card__icon"><i class="bi bi-snow"></i></span>

### Affogato
Very cold vanilla ice cream, very hot espresso poured over it at the table. Not really
a recipe, more a reliable way to end an evening.
:::
:::
:::

::: {.csf-section}
<h2 class="csf-section__title">Savoury, when we want something before the sugar</h2>
<p class="csf-section__sub">
Same rule applies. Nothing here goes near a flame.
</p>

::: {.csf-grid}
::: {.csf-card}
<span class="csf-card__icon"><i class="bi bi-droplet"></i></span>

### Hummus, the lazy version
Blitz a tin of chickpeas with tahini, lemon, garlic and plenty of olive oil. No
blender in the flat? Mash it with a fork and call it rustic. Bring carrots and bread.
:::

::: {.csf-card}
<span class="csf-card__icon"><i class="bi bi-basket"></i></span>

### Panzanella
Tear up yesterday's bread, add chopped tomatoes, red onion, basil, a lot of olive oil,
a splash of vinegar and salt. Twenty minutes of sitting still and the bread softens.
:::

::: {.csf-card}
<span class="csf-card__icon"><i class="bi bi-stars"></i></span>

### Carrot, orange and cumin
Grate carrots, squeeze in an orange, add a big pinch of cumin, oil and salt. Three
ingredients, five minutes, and it looks like somebody tried.
:::

::: {.csf-card}
<span class="csf-card__icon"><i class="bi bi-people"></i></span>

### A proper board
Cheese, olives, fruit, bread, nuts. Zero cooking, arranged on anything flat. Always
one of the first things to disappear.
:::
:::
:::

::: {.csf-section}
<h2 class="csf-section__title">Why these and not others</h2>

- **Nothing needs heat.** No oven, no hob, no risk of a shared kitchen being occupied.
- **Everything survives being made by fifteen people at once.** Recipes that need
  precision or timing do not work in a room full of people talking.
- **The steps split up.** Somebody crushes, somebody melts, somebody rolls. If a recipe
  can only be done by one pair of hands, it is a bad recipe for us.
- **You can repeat it alone.** Every one of these is doable in a bedroom with a fridge
  down the hall, which is the whole point of the club.
:::
